problem: Before this change, an explicit PELLIPSE=1 was accepted for R12 ASCII and binary output but omitted; the loss is reproduced in the associated display-header receipt.
change: R12 preflight rejects nonzero PELLIPSE, including bare and dollar-prefixed source names, before destination replacement. Missing and zero values retain the prior path; R14 and newer behavior remains unchanged.

validation.focused: Optimized HEADER selector covers nonzero refusal, zero acceptance, invalid group and duplicate alias rejection, ASCII/binary atomic destination preservation and same-adapter corrected retry; nonzero R14 save/import/resave/reopen and R2000 save/reimport pass.
validation.existing: Existing dimension migration and header alias fixtures pass.
validation.consumer: LibreCAD system-codec linetype selector passes 4957 assertions in 55 cases; bundled-codec selector passes 1282 assertions in 52 cases.
validation.image: Imported-common 144 metadata reexports and 176 wire retries pass; legacy two-layer 120 cells and 600 atomic retries pass.

limits: Zero PELLIPSE is still omitted by the existing R12 path; default semantics and omission reporting remain unresolved, so no lossless R12 claim is made.
R14/R2000 checks are library self-readback, not native application qualification.
Platform and native qualification remain open.
